AS ENUM ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n\n-- Teams table (tymove firmy)\nCREATE TABLE teams (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    year INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (year &gt;= 1 AND year &lt;= 3),\n    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,\n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()\n);\n\n-- Profiles table (extends auth.users)\nCREATE TABLE profiles (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role user_role NOT NULL DEFAULT 'student',\n    team_id UUID REFERENCES teams(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\n    is_verified BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,\n    school_email TEXT,\n    locale TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cs' CHECK (locale IN ('cs', 'en')),\n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),\n    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()\n);\n\n-- Pre-registered emails table (admin-imported from Excel)\nCREATE TABLE pre_registered_emails (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    team_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    role user_role NOT NULL DEFAULT 'student',\n    full_name TEXT,\n    claimed_by UUID REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\n    claimed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,\n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()\n);\n\n-- Verification codes table\nCREATE TABLE verification_codes (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    school_email TEXT NOT NULL,\n    code TEXT NOT NULL,\n    expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,\n    attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n    used BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,\n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()\n);\n\n-- Indexes for performance\nCREATE INDEX idx_profiles_team_id ON profiles(team_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_profiles_is_verified ON profiles(is_verified);\nCREATE INDEX idx_pre_registered_emails_email ON pre_registered_emails(email);",

        "contents": "4. **School Email Verification** - Unverified users must:\n   - Enter their school email (@pef.czu.cz)\n   - System checks if email is in pre-registered list\n   - If valid, sends 6-digit verification code\n   - User enters code to complete verification\n5. **Access Granted** - Verified users access the dashboard\n\n## Database Schema\n\n### Tables\n\n#### &#96;profiles&#96;\nExtended user info linked to Supabase auth.users\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK, FK → auth.users.id) | No | Links to Supabase auth |\n| full_name | TEXT | No | User's display name |\n| role | ENUM ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin') | No | User role |\n| team_id | UUID (FK → teams.id) | Yes | Assigned team (students/team leaders only) |\n| is_verified | BOOLEAN | No | School email verified? Default: false |\n| school_email | TEXT | Yes | Verified school email |\n| locale | TEXT | No | Preferred language ('cs', 'en'). Default: 'cs' |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Registration time |\n| updated_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Last update time |\n\n#### &#96;teams&#96;\nTeam companies (tymove firmy)\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK) | No | Team identifier |\n| name | TEXT | No | Team name |\n| year | INTEGER | No | Cohort year (1, 2, 3) |\n| is_active | BOOLEAN | No | Still active team? Default: true |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Creation time |\n\n#### &#96;pre_registered_emails&#96;\nAdmin-imported student list from Excel\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK) | No | Record identifier |\n| email | TEXT (unique) | No | School email from Excel |\n| team_id | UUID (FK → teams.id) | No | Assigned team |\n| role | ENUM | No | Expected role |\n| full_name | TEXT | Yes | Name from Excel (optional) |\n| claimed_by | UUID (FK → profiles.id) | Yes | User who claimed this email |\n| claimed_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | Yes | When claimed |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Import time |\n\n#### &#96;verification_codes&#96;",

          },
          "endPosition": {

          }
        },
        "contents": "Use MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Users table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth)\n-- Note: Synced via Next.js server actions, not database triggers\ncreate table public.users (\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\n  email text not null,\n  name text,\n  picture text,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\n);\n\n-- Role enum for profiles (authorization)\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n\n-- Profiles table (pre-created by admin, linked to user after verification)\n-- Focus: Authentication and authorization only\ncreate table public.profiles (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,  -- linked after OTP verification\n  work_email text unique not null,\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\n  removed_access timestamptz,  -- null = active, set = revoked\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\n-- Indexes for auth queries\ncreate index profiles_user_id_idx on public.profiles(user_id);\ncreate index profiles_work_email_idx on public.profiles(work_email);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Entity Relationships\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────┐       ┌─────────────────┐\n│   auth.users    │       │    profiles     │\n│  (Supabase)     │       │  (Auth only)    │\n├─────────────────┤       ├─────────────────┤\n│ id (uuid)       │◄──┐   │ id (uuid)       │\n│ email (google)  │   │   │ name            │\n│ ...auth fields  │   └───│ user_id (1:1)   │",

        "contents": "ALTER TABLE verification_codes ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\n\n-- Teams: Anyone authenticated can read active teams\nCREATE POLICY \"Anyone can view active teams\" ON teams\n    FOR SELECT USING (is_active = true);\n\n-- Teams: Only admins can modify teams\nCREATE POLICY \"Admins can manage teams\" ON teams\n    FOR ALL USING (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM profiles \n            WHERE profiles.id = auth.uid() \n            AND profiles.role = 'admin'\n        )\n    );\n\n-- Profiles: Users can read their own profile\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can view own profile\" ON profiles\n    FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = id);\n\n-- Profiles: Verified users can view other profiles in their team\nCREATE POLICY \"Verified users can view team profiles\" ON profiles\n    FOR SELECT USING (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM profiles AS viewer\n            WHERE viewer.id = auth.uid()\n            AND viewer.is_verified = true\n            AND (\n                viewer.team_id = profiles.team_id\n                OR viewer.role IN ('coach', 'admin')\n            )\n        )\n    );\n\n-- Profiles: Users can update their own profile\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can update own profile\" ON profiles\n    FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = id)\n    WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = id);\n\n-- Profiles: Admins can manage all profiles\nCREATE POLICY \"Admins can manage all profiles\" ON profiles\n    FOR ALL USING (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM profiles \n            WHERE profiles.id = auth.uid() \n            AND profiles.role = 'admin'\n        )\n    );\n\n-- Pre-registered emails: Users can check if their email exists\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can check pre-registered emails\" ON pre_registered_emails\n    FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL);\n\n-- Pre-registered emails: Only admins can modify\nCREATE POLICY \"Admins can manage pre-registered emails\" ON pre_registered_emails\n    FOR ALL USING (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM profiles ",

        "contents": "comment on function public.link_user_to_profile() is 'Trigger function that automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email. Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TRIGGERS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger on auth.users table to link profiles when email changes\n-- Runs AFTER UPDATE to ensure email change is committed\ndrop trigger if exists link_user_to_profile_trigger on auth.users;\n\ncreate trigger link_user_to_profile_trigger\nafter update of email on auth.users\nfor each row\nwhen (old.email is distinct from new.email)\nexecute function public.link_user_to_profile();\n\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- INITIAL DATA LINKING\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Link existing profiles to users based on current email matches\n-- This handles any existing data that needs to be linked\n-- Normalize both sides of comparison to handle case/whitespace differences\nupdate public.profiles p\nset user_id = u.id\nfrom public.users u\ninner join auth.users au on u.auth_user_id = au.id\nwhere lower(trim(p.work_email)) = lower(trim(au.email))\n  and (p.user_id is null or p.user_id = u.id);\n\ncomment on table public.profiles is 'User profile data with role and team membership. Pre-created by admin, linked to user after OTP verification. Automatically linked when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- GRANTS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Grant execute permissions for the trigger function\ngrant execute on function public.link_user_to_profile() to authenticated;",

signup\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nBEGIN\n    INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, full_name, role, team_id, is_verified, locale, created_at, updated_at)\n    VALUES (\n        NEW.id,\n        COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'full_name', ''),\n        COALESCE((NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'role')::user_role, 'student'),\n        CASE \n            WHEN NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'team_id' IS NOT NULL \n            THEN (NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'team_id')::UUID \n            ELSE NULL \n        END,\n        FALSE,\n        COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'locale', 'cs'),\n        NOW(),\n        NOW()\n    );\n    RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;\n\n-- Trigger to create profile on user         "contents": "-- Migration: Link users to profiles based on email matching\n-- Purpose: Automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email\n-- Affected tables: profiles, users, auth.users\n-- Special considerations: Runs automatically when user email changes in auth.users table\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger function to link profiles to users based on email matching\n-- Matches auth.users.email with profiles.work_email and links via public.users\n-- Runs with SECURITY DEFINER to access auth.users table\ncreate or replace function public.link_user_to_profile()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth\nas $$\ndeclare\n  v_user_id uuid;\n  v_auth_email text;\nbegin\n  -- Get the email from auth.users (use NEW.email after update)\n  v_auth_email := new.email;\n  \n  -- Only proceed if email is not null and has changed\n  if v_auth_email is null or v_auth_email = '' then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Find the public.users row that matches this auth.users.id\n  select id into v_user_id\n  from public.users\n  where auth_user_id = new.id;\n  \n  -- If no matching public.users row found, return early\n  if v_user_id is null then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Link profile to user if work_email matches auth.users.email\n  -- Only update if profile exists and is not already linked to a different user\n  -- Normalize both sides of comparison to handle case/whitespace differences\n  update public.profiles\n  set user_id = v_user_id\n  where lower(trim(work_email)) = lower(trim(v_auth_email))\n    and (user_id is null or user_id = v_user_id);\n  \n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.link_user_to_profile() is 'Trigger function that automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email. Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\n\n-- ============================================================================",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "-- Migration: Link users to profiles based on email matching",

          {
            "text": "-- Purpose: Automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "-- Affected tables: profiles, users, auth.users",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "-- Special considerations: Runs automatically when user email changes in auth.users table",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "-- ============================================================================",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "-- FUNCTIONS",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "-- ============================================================================",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "-- Create trigger function to link profiles to users based on email matching",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "-- Matches auth.users.email with profiles.work_email and links via public.users",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "-- Runs with SECURITY DEFINER to access auth.users table",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "create or replace function public.link_user_to_profile()",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "returns trigger",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "language plpgsql",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "security definer",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "set search_path = public, auth",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "as $$",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "declare",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "  v_user_id uuid;",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "  v_auth_email text;",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "begin",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "  -- Get the email from auth.users (use NEW.email after update)",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "  v_auth_email := new.email;",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "  ",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "  -- Only proceed if email is not null and has changed",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "  if v_auth_email is null or v_auth_email = '' then",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "    return new;",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "  end if;",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "  ",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "  -- Find the public.users row that matches this auth.users.id",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "  select id into v_user_id",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "  from public.users",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "  where auth_user_id = new.id;",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "  ",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "  -- If no matching public.users row found, return early",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "  if v_user_id is null then",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "    return new;",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "  end if;",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "  ",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "  -- Link profile to user if work_email matches auth.users.email",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "  -- Only update if profile exists and is not already linked to a different user",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "  -- Normalize both sides of comparison to handle case/whitespace differences",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "  update public.profiles",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "  set user_id = v_user_id",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "  where lower(trim(work_email)) = lower(trim(v_auth_email))",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "    and (user_id is null or user_id = v_user_id);",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "  ",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "  return new;",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "end;",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "$$;",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "comment on function public.link_user_to_profile() is 'Trigger function that automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email. Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "-- ============================================================================",
            "lineNumber": 55
          }
        ]
      },

        "contents": "export async function hasLinkedProfile(\n  supabaseClient: SupabaseClient\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n\n}\n\n/**\n * Gets the current authenticated user's profile, optionally with team data included\n * Uses RLS policy to ensure user can only see their own profile\n * @param supabaseClient - Supabase client to use. Must be provided to use existing client.\n * @param includeTeam - Whether to fetch team data along with the profile. Defaults to false.\n * @returns The profile data with team populated (if includeTeam is true) or null if not found\n */\nexport async function getCurrentUserProfile(\n  supabaseClient: SupabaseClient,\n  includeTeam: boolean = false,\n): Promise&lt;Profile | null&gt; {\n  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabaseClient.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (authError || !user) {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Build select query conditionally based on includeTeam parameter\n  const selectQuery = includeTeam\n    ? &#96;\n      *,\n      team:teams(*)\n    &#96;\n    : \"*\";\n\n  // Query profiles - RLS policy ensures user can only see their own profile\n  // The RLS policy checks: user_id in (select id from public.users where auth_user_id = auth.uid())\n  const { data: profile, error: queryError } = await supabaseClient\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(selectQuery)\n    .limit(1)\n    .single();\n\n  // Return null if query failed or no profile found\n  if (queryError || !profile) {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Transform the response to match Profile interface\n  // If team was fetched, extract it; otherwise set to null\n  const team = includeTeam ? ((profile as any).team || null) : null;\n\n  return {\n    ...profile,\n    team,\n  } as Profile;\n}\n\n/**\n * Creates an error URL with the given error message\n */\nexport function createErrorUrl(request: NextRequest, errorMessage: string): URL {\n  const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n}",

        "contents": "│ email (google)  │   │   │ name            │\n│ ...auth fields  │   └───│ user_id (1:1)   │\n└─────────────────┘       │ work_email      │\n                          │ role (enum)     │\n                          │ removed_access  │\n                          │ removed_access_by│──┐\n                          │ created_at      │  │\n                          │ updated_at      │  │\n                          └─────────────────┘  │\n                                    ▲          │\n                                    └──────────┘ (self-reference)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Verification Logic\n\n- **Unverified**: &#96;profiles.user_id IS NULL&#96; → User logged in with Google but hasn't verified work email\n- **Pending Approval**: Work email verified via OTP, but no profile exists with that email\n- **Verified &amp; Active**: &#96;profiles.user_id IS NOT NULL AND profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **Access Revoked**: &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NOT NULL&#96;\n\n## Constants\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// lib/constants/auth.ts\nexport const ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS = [\n  'studenti.czu.cz',\n  'pef.czu.cz',\n] as const;\n\nexport const isValidWorkEmailDomain = (email: string): boolean =&gt; {\n  const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();\n  return ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS.includes(domain as any);\n};\n\n// Profile roles (matches database enum)\nexport const PROFILE_ROLES = ['student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin'] as const;\nexport type ProfileRole = typeof PROFILE_ROLES[number];\n\n// Role hierarchy for permission checks\nexport const ROLE_HIERARCHY: Record&lt;ProfileRole, number&gt; = {\n  student: 0,\n  team_leader: 1,\n  coach: 2,\n  admin: 3,\n} as const;\n\nexport const hasMinimumRole = (userRole: ProfileRole, requiredRole: ProfileRole): boolean =&gt; {\n  return ROLE_HIERARCHY[userRole] &gt;= ROLE_HIERARCHY[requiredRole];\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking",

        "detailedLines": [

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 155
          },
          {
            "text": "### Verification Logic",
            "lineNumber": 156
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 157
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Unverified**: &#96;profiles.user_id IS NULL&#96; → User logged in with Google but hasn't verified work email",
            "lineNumber": 158
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Pending Approval**: Work email verified via OTP, but no profile exists with that email",
            "lineNumber": 159
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Verified &amp; Active**: &#96;profiles.user_id IS NOT NULL AND profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 160
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Access Revoked**: &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NOT NULL&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 161
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 162
          },
          {
            "text": "## Constants",
            "lineNumber": 163
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 164
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 165
          },
          {
            "text": "// lib/constants/auth.ts",
            "lineNumber": 166
          },
          {
            "text": "export const ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS = [",
            "lineNumber": 167
          },
          {
            "text": "  'studenti.czu.cz',",
            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "text": "  'pef.czu.cz',",
            "lineNumber": 169
          },
          {
            "text": "] as const;",
            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 171
          },
          {
            "text": "export const isValidWorkEmailDomain = (email: string): boolean =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 172
          },
          {
            "text": "  const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();",
            "lineNumber": 173
          },
          {
            "text": "  return ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS.includes(domain as any);",
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "text": "};",
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 176
          },
          {
            "text": "// Profile roles (matches database enum)",
            "lineNumber": 177
          },
          {
            "text": "export const PROFILE_ROLES = ['student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin'] as const;",
            "lineNumber": 178
          },
          {
            "text": "export type ProfileRole = typeof PROFILE_ROLES[number];",
            "lineNumber": 179
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {
            "text": "// Role hierarchy for permission checks",
            "lineNumber": 181
          },
          {
            "text": "export const ROLE_HIERARCHY: Record&lt;ProfileRole, number&gt; = {",
            "lineNumber": 182
          },
          {
            "text": "  student: 0,",
            "lineNumber": 183
          },
          {
            "text": "  team_leader: 1,",
            "lineNumber": 184
          },
          {
            "text": "  coach: 2,",
            "lineNumber": 185
          },
          {
            "text": "  admin: 3,",
            "lineNumber": 186
          },
          {
            "text": "} as const;",
            "lineNumber": 187
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 188
          },
          {
            "text": "export const hasMinimumRole = (userRole: ProfileRole, requiredRole: ProfileRole): boolean =&gt; {",
            "lineNumber": 189
          },
          {
            "text": "  return ROLE_HIERARCHY[userRole] &gt;= ROLE_HIERARCHY[requiredRole];",
            "lineNumber": 190
          },
          {
            "text": "};",
            "lineNumber": 191
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 192
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 193
          },
          {
            "text": "## Supabase Configuration Changes",

            "lineNumber": 195

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "[auth]",
            "lineNumber": 199
          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 200

        "contents": "export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n    // Check if code matches\n    if (verificationCode.code !== code) {\n      // Increment attempts\n      await supabase\n        .from(\"verification_codes\")\n        .update({ attempts: verificationCode.attempts + 1 })\n        .eq(\"id\", verificationCode.id);\n\n      const remainingAttempts = MAX_ATTEMPTS - verificationCode.attempts - 1;\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        {\n          error: &#96;Neplatný kód. Zbývající pokusy: ${remainingAttempts}&#96;,\n        },\n        { status: 400 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Code is valid! Mark as used\n    await supabase\n      .from(\"verification_codes\")\n      .update({ used: true })\n      .eq(\"id\", verificationCode.id);\n\n    // Get role and team from pre_registered_emails\n    const { data: preRegistered, error: preRegError } = await supabase\n      .from(\"pre_registered_emails\")\n      .select(\"role, team_id\")\n      .eq(\"email\", school_email.toLowerCase())\n      .single();\n\n    if (preRegError || !preRegistered) {\n      console.error(\"Failed to get pre_registered_emails:\", preRegError);\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Nepodařilo se načíst data z registrace\" },\n        { status: 500 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Update profile: set is_verified, school_email, role, and team_id from pre_registered\n    const { error: profileError } = await supabase\n      .from(\"profiles\")\n      .update({\n        is_verified: true,\n        school_email: school_email.toLowerCase(),\n        role: preRegistered.role,\n        team_id: preRegistered.team_id,\n      })\n      .eq(\"id\", user.id);\n\n    if (profileError) {\n      console.error(\"Failed to update profile:\", profileError);\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Nepodařilo se aktualizovat profil\" },\n        { status: 500 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Claim the pre-registered email\n    await supabase\n      .from(\"pre_registered_emails\")\n      .update({\n        claimed_by: user.id,\n        claimed_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n      })\n      .eq(\"email\", school_email.toLowerCase());\n\n    return NextResponse.json({\n      success: true,\n      verified: true,\n\n}",

        "contents": "-- Tappka Reservation System Migration\n-- Creates tables for rooms, reservations, recurring schedules, cowork participants, room issues, and schedule breaks\n\n-- ============================================\n-- EXTENSIONS\n-- ============================================\n\n-- Required for EXCLUDE constraint (preventing overlapping reservations)\nCREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS btree_gist;\n\n-- ============================================\n-- ENUM TYPES\n-- ============================================\n\n-- Reservation types\nCREATE TYPE reservation_type AS ENUM ('personal', 'training_session', 'houston_calling');\n\n-- Issue types for room problems\nCREATE TYPE issue_type AS ENUM ('locked', 'mess', 'technical', 'other');\nCREATE TYPE issue_status AS ENUM ('open', 'resolved');\n\n-- Schedule break types (Days of Joy, holidays, etc.)\nCREATE TYPE schedule_break_type AS ENUM ('days_of_joy', 'holiday', 'other');\n\n-- ============================================\n-- TABLES\n-- ============================================\n\n-- Rooms table\n-- Stores all reservable rooms with their rules\nCREATE TABLE rooms (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n    code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,          -- 'd126', 'd132', etc. (used in URLs)\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- 'D126', 'Tichá místnost', etc.\n    description TEXT,                    -- Optional description\n    available_days INTEGER[],            -- NULL = all days, [3] = Wednesday only (0=Sun, 1=Mon, etc.)\n    can_have_ts BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,  -- Can have Training Sessions?\n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()\n);\n\n-- Recurring schedules table\n-- Stores recurring Training Session schedules set by coaches\nCREATE TABLE recurring_schedules (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),",

Default: false |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Creation time |\n\n### Database Trigger\n\nOn new user signup (auth.users insert), automatically create a profile record:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nBEGIN\n  INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, full_name, role, is_verified, created_at, updated_at)\n  VALUES (\n    NEW.id,\n    COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'full_name', ''),\n    COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'role', 'student'),\n    FALSE,\n    NOW(),\n    NOW()\n  );\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;\n\nCREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created\n  AFTER INSERT ON auth.users\n  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user();\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## UI Screens\n\n### 1.         "contents": "CREATE POLICY \"Admins can manage pre-registered emails\" ON pre_registered_emails\n    FOR ALL USING (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM profiles \n            WHERE profiles.id = auth.uid() \n            AND profiles.role = 'admin'\n        )\n    );\n\n-- Verification codes: Users can only see their own codes\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can view own verification codes\" ON verification_codes\n    FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = user_id);\n\n-- Verification codes: Users can create codes for themselves\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can create own verification codes\" ON verification_codes\n    FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id);\n\n-- Verification codes: Users can update their own codes (for attempts/used)\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can update own verification codes\" ON verification_codes\n    FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = user_id)\n    WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id);\n\n-- Verification codes: Admins can manage all codes\nCREATE POLICY \"Admins can manage verification codes\" ON verification_codes\n    FOR ALL USING (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM profiles \n            WHERE profiles.id = auth.uid() \n            AND profiles.role = 'admin'\n        )\n    );\n\n-- Insert some sample teams for development\nINSERT INTO teams (name, year, is_active) VALUES\n    ('Tuuli', 1, true),\n    ('Tuuli', 1, true),\n    ('Impact', 2, true),\n    ('Growth', 2, true),\n    ('Legacy', 3, true);",

        "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\n        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\n        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\n        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\n        L --&gt; M\n        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\n        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\n        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}\n        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]\n        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email\n\n   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user\n   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nTwo tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:\n\n1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions\n2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control\n\n**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.\n\nUse MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",

            "text": "Two tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "Use MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",
            "lineNumber": 96
          }

        "contents": "/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has a linked profile\n * @param supabaseClient - Supabase client to use. Must be provided to use existing client.\n * @returns true if user has a linked profile, false otherwise\n */\nexport async function hasLinkedProfile(\n  supabaseClient: SupabaseClient\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabaseClient.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (authError || !user) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Query profiles directly - RLS policy ensures user can only see their own profile\n  // The RLS policy checks: user_id in (select id from public.users where auth_user_id = auth.uid())\n  // This is more reliable than nested selects with RLS\n  const { data: profiles, error: queryError } = await supabaseClient\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(\"id\")\n    .limit(1);\n\n  // Return false if query failed or no profiles found\n  if (queryError || !profiles) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Check if at least one profile exists\n  return Array.isArray(profiles) &amp;&amp; profiles.length &gt; 0;\n}\n\n/**\n * Gets the current authenticated user's profile, optionally with team data included\n * Uses RLS policy to ensure user can only see their own profile\n * @param supabaseClient - Supabase client to use. Must be provided to use existing client.\n * @param includeTeam - Whether to fetch team data along with the profile. Defaults to false.\n * @returns The profile data with team populated (if includeTeam is true) or null if not found\n */",

        "contents": "/**\n * Coach dashboard for managing Training Sessions and schedule breaks\n * Only accessible by coaches and admins\n */\nexport default async function ReservationSettingsPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Check if user is coach or admin\n  const profile = await getCurrentUserProfile(supabase)\n\n  if (profile?.role !== \"coach\" &amp;&amp; profile?.role !== \"admin\") {\n    redirect(\"/dashboard/reservations\");\n  }\n\n  const isAdmin = profile?.role === \"admin\";\n\n  // Fetch all data\n  const [roomsResult, schedulesResult, breaksResult, teamsResult, issuesResult] = await Promise.all([\n    // Rooms that can have TS\n    supabase\n      .from(\"rooms\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"can_have_ts\", true)\n      .order(\"code\"),\n\n    // Recurring schedules with team info\n    supabase\n      .from(\"recurring_schedules\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        team:teams(id, name)\n      &#96;)\n      .gte(\"valid_until\", new Date().toISOString().split(\"T\")[0])\n      .order(\"day_of_week\"),\n\n    // Schedule breaks\n    supabase\n      .from(\"schedule_breaks\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .gte(\"end_date\", new Date().toISOString().split(\"T\")[0])\n      .order(\"start_date\"),\n\n    // Teams for TS assignment\n    supabase\n      .from(\"teams\")\n      .select(\"id, name, year\")\n      .eq(\"is_active\", true)\n      .order(\"year\")\n      .order(\"name\"),\n\n    // Room issues\n    supabase\n      .from(\"room_issues\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        reporter:profiles!reported_by(id, full_name),\n        resolver:profiles!resolved_by(id, full_name)\n      &#96;)\n      .order(\"created_at\", { ascending: false })\n      .limit(50),\n  ]);\n\n  const rooms = (roomsResult.data || []) as Room[];\n  const schedules = (schedulesResult.data || []) as (RecurringSchedule &amp; { room: Room; team: { id: string; name: string } })[];\n  const breaks = (breaksResult.data || []) as ScheduleBreak[];\n  const teams = teamsResult.data || [];\n  const issues = (issuesResult.data || []) as (RoomIssue &amp;         "contents": "- Příklad: &#96;page.tsx&#96; je server, &#96;login-form.tsx&#96; je client\n\n#### 2. Supabase integrace\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// Server component\nconst supabase = await createClient();\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n// Client component  \nconst supabase = createClient();\nawait supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 3. Ochrana routes\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// V page.tsx nebo layout.tsx\nif (!user) redirect(\"/\");\nif (!profile?.is_verified) redirect(\"/verify\");\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 4. Formuláře\n- useState pro state\n- Async submit handler\n- Error handling s českými hláškami\n- Loading stavy (isLoading)\n\n#### 5. Fetch na API routes\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nconst response = await fetch(\"/api/verify/send-code\", {\n  method: \"POST\",\n  headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\n  body: JSON.stringify({ school_email }),\n});\nconst data = await response.json();\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Existující databázové tabulky\n\n| Tabulka | Účel |\n|---------|------|\n| &#96;profiles&#96; | Rozšíření auth.users (jméno, role, tým, verified) |\n| &#96;teams&#96; | Týmové firmy (Viento, Tuuli, Aero) |\n| &#96;pre_registered_emails&#96; | Seznam povolených školních emailů |\n| &#96;verification_codes&#96; | Dočasné kódy pro ověření |\n\n### Existující role\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TYPE user_role AS ENUM ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Sidebar navigace (app-sidebar.tsx)\n\nUž existuje placeholder pro Rezervace:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n{\n  title: \"Rezervace\",\n  url: \"/dashboard/reservations\",\n  icon: CalendarDays,\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Otázky k diskusi\n\n### 1. Co se bude rezervovat?\n- [ ] Místnosti v TAP prostorách?\n- [ ] Jaké typy místností? (zasedačky, kanceláře, společné prostory?)\n- [ ] Jsou nějaká specifická pravidla pro rezervace?\n\n### 2. Kdo může rezervovat?\n- [ ] Všichni ověření uživatelé?\n- [ ] Jen určité role?\n- [ ] Potřebuje se něco schvalovat?\n\n### 3. Jak dlouhé mohou být rezervace?\n- [ ] Minimální/maximální délka?\n- [ ] Celý den vs. časové sloty?\n- [ ] Opakující se rezervace?\n\n### 4. Co když jsou konflikty?\n- [ ] First-come-first-served?",

        "contents": "export async function hasLinkedProfile(\n  supabaseClient: SupabaseClient\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n\n}\n\n/**\n * Gets the current authenticated user's profile, optionally with team data included\n * Uses RLS policy to ensure user can only see their own profile\n * @param supabaseClient - Supabase client to use. Must be provided to use existing client.\n * @param includeTeam - Whether to fetch team data along with the profile. Defaults to false.\n * @returns The profile data with team populated (if includeTeam is true) or null if not found\n */\nexport async function getCurrentUserProfile(\n  supabaseClient: SupabaseClient,\n  includeTeam: boolean = false,\n): Promise&lt;Profile | null&gt; {\n  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabaseClient.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (authError || !user) {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Build select query conditionally based on includeTeam parameter\n  const selectQuery = includeTeam\n    ? &#96;\n      *,\n      team:teams(*)\n    &#96;\n    : \"*\";\n\n  // Query profiles - RLS policy ensures user can only see their own profile\n  // The RLS policy checks: user_id in (select id from public.users where auth_user_id = auth.uid())\n  const { data: profile, error: queryError } = await supabaseClient\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(selectQuery)\n    .limit(1)\n    .single();\n\n  // Return null if query failed or no profile found\n  if (queryError || !profile) {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Transform the response to match Profile interface\n  // If team was fetched, extract it; otherwise set to null\n  const team = includeTeam ? ((profile as any).team || null) : null;\n\n  return {\n    ...profile,\n    team,\n  } as Profile;\n}\n\n/**\n * Creates an error URL with the given error message\n */\nexport function createErrorUrl(request: NextRequest, errorMessage: string): URL {\n  const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Main reservations page showing all rooms and user's reservations\n */\nexport default async function ReservationsPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Get current user\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  // Fetch rooms with current reservations and issues\n  const now = new Date().toISOString();\n\n  const [roomsResult, reservationsResult, issuesResult, myReservationsResult, joinedIdsResult, coworksResult] = await Promise.all([\n    // All rooms\n    supabase\n      .from(\"rooms\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .order(\"code\"),\n\n    // Current and upcoming reservations for today\n    supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .gte(\"end_time\", now)\n      .lte(\"start_time\", new Date(Date.now() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString())\n      .order(\"start_time\"),\n\n    // Open issues\n    supabase\n      .from(\"room_issues\")\n      .select(\"room_id, issue_type\")\n      .eq(\"status\", \"open\"),\n\n    // User's own reservations\n    supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name)\n      &#96;)\n      .eq(\"user_id\", user?.id ?? \"\")\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .gte(\"end_time\", now)\n      .order(\"start_time\")\n      .limit(10),\n\n    // Get reservation IDs user has joined\n    supabase\n      .from(\"cowork_participants\")\n      .select(\"reservation_id\")\n      .eq(\"user_id\", user?.id ?? \"\"),\n\n    // Available coworks (open for cowork, active, upcoming - include all, we'll filter later)\n    supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        user:profiles!reservations_user_id_fkey(id, full_name),\n        team:teams(id, name),\n        cowork_participants(\n          id,\n          user_id,\n          joined_at,\n          user:profiles(id, full_name)\n        )\n      &#96;)\n      .eq(\"is_cowork_open\", true)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .gte(\"end_time\", now)\n      .order(\"start_time\")\n      .limit(50), // Increased limit to catch both joined and available\n  ]);\n\n  // Process rooms with status\n  const rooms = roomsResult.data || [];\n}",

        "contents": "import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from \"next/server\";\nimport {\n  OPERATING_HOURS,\n  MAX_ADVANCE_BOOKING_DAYS,\n  type CreateReservationInput,\n} from \"@/lib/reservations/types\";\nimport { isRoomAvailableOnDay } from \"@/lib/reservations/utils\";\nimport { getCurrentUserProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * GET /api/reservations\n * Fetch reservations with optional filters\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n    if (!user) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Neautorizováno\" }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n    const roomId = searchParams.get(\"room_id\");\n    const startDate = searchParams.get(\"start_date\");\n    const endDate = searchParams.get(\"end_date\");\n    const userId = searchParams.get(\"user_id\");\n\n    let query = supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        user:profiles(id, full_name),\n        team:teams(id, name)\n      &#96;)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .order(\"start_time\");\n\n    if (roomId) {\n      query = query.eq(\"room_id\", roomId);\n    }\n\n    if (startDate) {\n      query = query.gte(\"end_time\", startDate);\n    }\n\n    if (endDate) {\n      query = query.lte(\"start_time\", endDate);\n    }\n\n    if (userId) {\n      query = query.eq(\"user_id\", userId);\n    }\n\n    const { data, error } = await query;\n\n    if (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error fetching reservations:\", error);\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Nepodařilo se načíst rezervace\" },\n        { status: 500 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    return NextResponse.json({ data });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(\"GET /api/reservations error:\", error);\n    return NextResponse.json(\n      { error: \"Interní chyba serveru\" },\n      { status: 500 }\n    );\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * POST /api/reservations\n * Create a new reservation\n */\nexport async function POST(request: NextRequest) {\n  try\n}",

        "contents": "4. **School Email Verification** - Unverified users must:\n   - Enter their school email (@pef.czu.cz)\n   - System checks if email is in pre-registered list\n   - If valid, sends 6-digit verification code\n   - User enters code to complete verification\n5. **Access Granted** - Verified users access the dashboard\n\n## Database Schema\n\n### Tables\n\n#### &#96;profiles&#96;\nExtended user info linked to Supabase auth.users\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK, FK → auth.users.id) | No | Links to Supabase auth |\n| full_name | TEXT | No | User's display name |\n| role | ENUM ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin') | No | User role |\n| team_id | UUID (FK → teams.id) | Yes | Assigned team (students/team leaders only) |\n| is_verified | BOOLEAN | No | School email verified? Default: true |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Creation time |\n\n#### &#96;pre_registered_emails&#96;\nAdmin-imported student list from Excel\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK) | No | Record identifier |\n| email | TEXT (unique) | No | School email from Excel |\n| team_id | UUID (FK → teams.id) | No | Assigned team |\n| role | ENUM | No | Expected role |\n| full_name | TEXT | Yes | Name from Excel (optional) |\n| claimed_by | UUID (FK → profiles.id) | Yes | User who claimed this email |\n| claimed_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | Yes | When claimed |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Import time |\n\n#### &#96;verification_codes&#96;",

start_time),\n    \n    -- Prevent overlapping active reservations for the same room\n    CONSTRAINT no_overlap EXCLUDE USING gist (\n        room_id WITH =,\n        tstzrange(start_time, end_time) WITH &amp;&amp;\n    ) WHERE (status = 'active')\n);\n\n-- Cowork participants table\n-- Stores users who joined open cowork reservations\nCREATE TABLE cowork_participants (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n    reservation_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES reservations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    joined_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),\n    \n    -- Each user can only join a reservation once\n    UNIQUE(reservation_id, user_id)\n);\n\n-- Room issues table\n-- Stores reported problems with rooms\nCREATE TABLE room_issues (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),",

        "contents": "/**\n * Coach dashboard for managing Training Sessions and schedule breaks\n * Only accessible by coaches and admins\n */\nexport default async function ReservationSettingsPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Check if user is coach or admin\n  const profile = await getCurrentUserProfile(supabase)\n\n  if (profile?.role !== \"coach\" &amp;&amp; profile?.role !== \"admin\") {\n    redirect(\"/dashboard/reservations\");\n  }\n\n  const isAdmin = profile?.role === \"admin\";\n\n  // Fetch all data\n  const [roomsResult, schedulesResult, breaksResult, teamsResult, issuesResult] = await Promise.all([\n    // Rooms that can have TS\n    supabase\n      .from(\"rooms\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"can_have_ts\", true)\n      .order(\"code\"),\n\n    // Recurring schedules with team info\n    supabase\n      .from(\"recurring_schedules\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        team:teams(id, name)\n      &#96;)\n      .gte(\"valid_until\", new Date().toISOString().split(\"T\")[0])\n      .order(\"day_of_week\"),\n\n    // Schedule breaks\n    supabase\n      .from(\"schedule_breaks\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .gte(\"end_date\", new Date().toISOString().split(\"T\")[0])\n      .order(\"start_date\"),\n\n    // Teams for TS assignment\n    supabase\n      .from(\"teams\")\n      .select(\"id, name, year\")\n      .eq(\"is_active\", true)\n      .order(\"year\")\n      .order(\"name\"),\n\n    // Room issues\n    supabase\n      .from(\"room_issues\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        reporter:profiles!reported_by(id, full_name),\n        resolver:profiles!resolved_by(id, full_name)\n      &#96;)\n      .order(\"created_at\", { ascending: false })\n      .limit(50),\n  ]);\n\n  const rooms = (roomsResult.data || []) as Room[];\n  const schedules = (schedulesResult.data || []) as (RecurringSchedule &amp; { room: Room; team: { id: string; name: string } })[];\n  const breaks = (breaksResult.data || []) as ScheduleBreak[];\n  const teams = teamsResult.data || [];\n  const issues = (issuesResult.data || []) as (RoomIssue &amp;         "contents": "import { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\n\n/**\n * GET /api/reservations/[id]/participants\n * Get all participants of a cowork reservation\n */\nexport async function GET(\n  request: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: Promise&lt;{ id: string }&gt; }\n) {\n  try {\n    const { id } = await params;\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n\n    // Check authentication\n    const {\n      data: { user },\n    } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n    if (!user) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Neautorizovaný přístup\" }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    // Fetch participants with user info\n    const { data: participants, error } = await supabase\n      .from(\"cowork_participants\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        id,\n        reservation_id,\n        user_id,\n        joined_at,\n        user:profiles!cowork_participants_user_id_fkey(id, full_name)\n      &#96;)\n      .eq(\"reservation_id\", id)\n      .order(\"joined_at\", { ascending: true });\n\n    if (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error fetching participants:\", error);\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Nepodařilo se načíst účastníky\" },\n        { status: 500 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    return NextResponse.json({ data: participants });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(\"Participants API error:\", error);\n    return NextResponse.json(\n      { error: \"Interní chyba serveru\" },\n      { status: 500 }\n    );\n  }\n}",

        },
        "contents": "/**\n * GET /api/rooms/[code]/quick-status\n * Get quick status info for QR code scans\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest, { params }: RouteParams) {\n  try {\n    const { code } = await params;\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    \n    // Check authentication\n    const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n    if (!user) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Neautorizováno\" }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    // Fetch room by code\n    const { data: room, error: roomError } = await supabase\n      .from(\"rooms\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"code\", code.toLowerCase())\n      .single();\n\n    if (roomError || !room) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Místnost nenalezena\" },\n        { status: 404 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    const now = new Date();\n    const nowIso = now.toISOString();\n\n    // Fetch current reservation\n    const { data: currentReservation } = await supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        user:profiles(id, full_name),\n        team:teams(id, name)\n      &#96;)\n      .eq(\"room_id\", room.id)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .lte(\"start_time\", nowIso)\n      .gt(\"end_time\", nowIso)\n      .single();\n\n    // Fetch open issues\n    const { data: issues } = await supabase\n      .from(\"room_issues\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"room_id\", room.id)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"open\");\n\n    const roomIssues = (issues || []) as RoomIssue[];\n    const isLocked = roomIssues.some((i) =&gt; i.issue_type === \"locked\");\n    const otherIssues = roomIssues\n      .filter((i) =&gt; i.issue_type !== \"locked\")\n      .map((i) =&gt; {\n        const labels: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n          mess: \"Nepořádek\",\n          technical: \"Technický problém\",\n          other: \"Jiné\",\n        };\n        return labels[i.issue_type] || i.issue_type;\n      });\n\n    // Determine status\n    let status: 'free' | 'occupied' | 'locked' = 'free';\n    if (isLocked) {\n      status = 'locked';\n    }\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./supabase/migrations/20260131000000_initial_schema.sql",

        },
        "contents": "-- References the new users table instead of auth.users\ncreate table public.profiles (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  picture text,\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,\n  work_email text unique not null,\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\n  team_id uuid references public.teams(id) on delete set null,\n  phone_number text,\n  personal_email text,\n  date_of_birth date,\n  removed_access timestamptz,\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\ncomment on table public.profiles is 'User profile data with role and team membership. Pre-created by admin, linked to user after OTP verification.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger function to automatically update updated_at column\ncreate or replace function public.handle_updated_at()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity invoker\nset search_path = ''\nas $$\nbegin\n  new.updated_at := now();\n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.handle_updated_at() is 'Trigger function that automatically updates the updated_at column to the current timestamp on row updates.';\n\n-- Create trigger function to populate public.users on auth.users creation\n-- Extracts Google OAuth data from auth.users.raw_user_meta_data and auth.users.email\ncreate or replace function public.handle_new_auth_user()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth\nas $$\ndeclare\n  v_google_email text;\n  v_google_full_name text;\n  v_google_profile_picture text;\n  v_raw_meta_data jsonb;\nbegin\n  v_raw_meta_data := new.raw_user_meta_data;",

        "contents": "/**\n * GET /api/room-issues\n * Fetch room issues with optional filters\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n    if (!user) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: \"Neautorizováno\" }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n    const roomId = searchParams.get(\"room_id\");\n    const status = searchParams.get(\"status\");\n\n    let query = supabase\n      .from(\"room_issues\")\n      .select(&#96;\n        *,\n        room:rooms(id, code, name),\n        reporter:profiles!reported_by(id, full_name),\n        resolver:profiles!resolved_by(id, full_name)\n      &#96;)\n      .order(\"created_at\", { ascending: false });\n\n    if (roomId) {\n      query = query.eq(\"room_id\", roomId);\n    }\n\n    if (status) {\n      query = query.eq(\"status\", status);\n    }\n\n    const { data, error } = await query;\n\n    if (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error fetching room issues:\", error);\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: \"Nepodařilo se načíst problémy\" },\n        { status: 500 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    return NextResponse.json({ data });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(\"GET /api/room-issues error:\", error);\n    return NextResponse.json(\n      { error: \"Interní chyba serveru\" },\n      { status: 500 }\n    );\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * POST /api/room-issues\n * Report a new room issue\n */\nexport async function POST(request: NextRequest) {\n  try\n}",

        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./app/dashboard/reservations/[code]/qr/page.tsx",

            "column": 1

        },
        "contents": "/**\n * QR Code quick status page\n * Shows instant room availability status with split-screen colored design\n */\nexport default async function QRQuickStatusPage({ params }: QRPageProps) {\n  const { code } = await params;\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n\n  // Fetch room by code\n  const { data: room, error: roomError } = await supabase\n    .from(\"rooms\")\n    .select(\"*\")\n    .eq(\"code\", code.toLowerCase())\n    .single();\n\n  if (roomError || !room) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  const now = new Date();\n  const nowIso = now.toISOString();\n\n  // Fetch current reservation\n  const { data: currentReservation } = await supabase\n    .from(\"reservations\")\n    .select(&#96;\n      *,\n      user:profiles(id, full_name),\n      team:teams(id, name)\n    &#96;)\n    .eq(\"room_id\", room.id)\n    .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n    .lte(\"start_time\", nowIso)\n    .gt(\"end_time\", nowIso)\n    .single();\n\n  // Fetch open issues\n  const { data: issues } = await supabase\n    .from(\"room_issues\")\n    .select(\"*\")\n    .eq(\"room_id\", room.id)\n    .eq(\"status\", \"open\");\n\n  const roomIssues = (issues || []) as RoomIssue[];\n  const isLocked = roomIssues.some((i) =&gt; i.issue_type === \"locked\");\n  const otherIssues = roomIssues\n    .filter((i) =&gt; i.issue_type !== \"locked\")\n    .map((i) =&gt; {\n      const labels: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {\n        mess: \"Nepořádek\",\n        technical: \"Technický problém\",\n        other: \"Jiné\",\n      };\n      return labels[i.issue_type] || i.issue_type;\n    });\n\n  // Determine status\n  let status: 'free' | 'occupied' | 'locked' = 'free';\n  if (isLocked) {\n    status = 'locked';\n  } else if (currentReservation) {\n    status = 'occupied';\n  }\n\n  // Build response data\n  const quickStatusData = {\n    room: {\n      id: room.id,\n      code: room.code,\n      name: room.name,\n      description: room.description,\n    },\n    status,\n    issues: {\n      isLocked,\n      otherIssues,\n    },\n  };\n\n  // Add current reservation details if occupied\n  let currentReservationData = undefined;\n  let alternativeRooms = undefined;\n\n  if (currentReservation) {\n    const endTime = new Date(currentReservation.end_time);\n}",

        "contents": "CREATE INDEX idx_profiles_is_verified ON profiles(is_verified);\nCREATE INDEX idx_pre_registered_emails_email ON pre_registered_emails(email);\nCREATE INDEX idx_pre_registered_emails_claimed_by ON pre_registered_emails(claimed_by);\nCREATE INDEX idx_verification_codes_user_id ON verification_codes(user_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_verification_codes_school_email ON verification_codes(school_email);\nCREATE INDEX idx_verification_codes_expires_at ON verification_codes(expires_at);\n\n-- Function to handle new user signup\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nBEGIN\n    INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, full_name, role, team_id, is_verified, locale, created_at, updated_at)\n    VALUES (\n        NEW.id,\n        COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'full_name', ''),\n        COALESCE((NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'role')::user_role, 'student'),\n        CASE \n            WHEN NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'team_id' IS NOT NULL \n            THEN (NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'team_id')::UUID \n            ELSE NULL \n        END,\n        FALSE,\n        COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data-&gt;&gt;'locale', 'cs'),\n        NOW(),\n        NOW()\n    );\n    RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;\n\n-- Trigger to create profile on user signup\nCREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created\n    AFTER INSERT ON auth.users\n    FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user();\n\n-- Function to update updated_at timestamp\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_updated_at_column()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nBEGIN\n    NEW.updated_at = NOW();\n    RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;\n\n-- Trigger to auto-update updated_at on         "contents": "export default async function RoomDetailPage({ params }: RoomDetailPageProps) {\n\n\n  const [reservationsResult, issuesResult, alternativeRoomsResult, breaksResult] = await Promise.all([\n    // Reservations for this room (past 7 days + next 14 days for calendar navigation)\n    supabase\n      .from(\"reservations\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"room_id\", room.id)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\")\n      .gte(\"start_time\", oneWeekAgo.toISOString())\n      .lte(\"start_time\", twoWeeksLater.toISOString())\n      .order(\"start_time\"),\n\n    // Open issues for this room\n    supabase\n      .from(\"room_issues\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .eq(\"room_id\", room.id)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"open\")\n      .order(\"created_at\", { ascending: false }),\n\n    // Alternative rooms for suggestions\n    supabase\n      .from(\"rooms\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .neq(\"id\", room.id)\n      .order(\"code\"),\n\n    // Schedule breaks for the date range (past 7 + future 14 days)\n    supabase\n      .from(\"schedule_breaks\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .lte(\"start_date\", twoWeeksLaterStr)\n      .gte(\"end_date\", oneWeekAgoStr)\n      .order(\"start_date\"),\n  ]);\n\n  const reservations = (reservationsResult.data || []) as Reservation[];\n  const issues = (issuesResult.data || []) as RoomIssue[];\n  const allAlternativeRooms = (alternativeRoomsResult.data || []) as Room[];\n  const scheduleBreaks = (breaksResult.data || []) as ScheduleBreak[];\n\n  // Sort alternative rooms based on current room type\n}",

        "contents": "CREATE POLICY \"Admins can manage pre-registered emails\" ON pre_registered_emails\n    FOR ALL USING (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM profiles \n            WHERE profiles.id = auth.uid() \n            AND profiles.role = 'admin'\n        )\n    );\n\n-- Verification codes: Users can only see their own codes\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can view own verification codes\" ON verification_codes\n    FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = user_id);\n\n-- Verification codes: Users can create codes for themselves\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can create own verification codes\" ON verification_codes\n    FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id);\n\n-- Verification codes: Users can update their own codes (for attempts/used)\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can update own verification codes\" ON verification_codes\n    FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = user_id)\n    WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id);\n\n-- Verification codes: Admins can manage all codes\nCREATE POLICY \"Admins can manage verification codes\" ON verification_codes\n    FOR ALL USING (\n        EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM profiles \n            WHERE profiles.id = auth.uid() \n            AND profiles.role = 'admin'\n        )\n    );\n\n-- Insert some sample teams for development\nINSERT INTO teams (name, year, is_active) VALUES\n    ('Tuuli', 1, true),\n    ('Tuuli', 1, true),\n    ('Impact', 2, true),\n    ('Growth', 2, true),\n    ('Legacy', 3, true);",

        "contents": "-- Migration: Initial schema setup\n-- Purpose: Creates complete database schema with tables, triggers, and restrictive RLS policies\n-- Affected tables: users, profiles, teams\n-- Special considerations: All RLS policies are restrictive - admin operations require service_role or application-level checks\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- ENUM TYPES\n-- ============================================================================\n\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TABLES\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create users table (custom table, separate from auth.users)\n-- Stores Google OAuth user data and OTP tracking\n-- Linked to auth.users via auth_user_id for authentication checks\ncreate table public.users (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  auth_user_id uuid unique references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\n  google_email text not null unique,\n  suggested_work_email text,\n  verified_work_email text,\n  verified_work_email_at timestamptz,\n  google_profile_picture text,\n  google_full_name text,\n  last_otp_sent_at timestamptz,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\n);\n\ncomment on table public.users is 'Custom users table storing Google OAuth user data and OTP tracking. Separate from auth.users but linked via auth_user_id for authentication.';\n\n-- Create teams table\ncreate table public.teams (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  picture text,\n  color text,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\n);\n\ncomment on table public.teams is 'Team information for organizing users into groups.';\n\n-- Create profiles table (pre-created by admin, linked to user after verification)\n-- References the new users table instead of auth.users\ncreate table public.profiles (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),",

INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (year &gt;= 1 AND year &lt;= 3),\n    is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,\n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()\n);\n\n-- Profiles table (extends auth.users)\nCREATE TABLE profiles (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    full_name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role user_role NOT NULL DEFAULT 'student',\n    team_id UUID REFERENCES teams(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\n    is_verified BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,\n    school_email TEXT,\n    locale TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cs' CHECK (locale IN ('cs', 'en')),\n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),\n    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()\n);\n\n-- Pre-registered emails table (admin-imported from Excel)\nCREATE TABLE pre_registered_emails (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    team_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    role user_role NOT NULL DEFAULT now()\n);\n\n-- Indexes for performance\nCREATE INDEX idx_profiles_team_id ON profiles(team_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_profiles_is_verified ON profiles(is_verified);\nCREATE INDEX         "contents": "CREATE POLICY \"Admins can manage rooms\" ON rooms\n    FOR ALL TO authenticated\n    USING (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles WHERE id = auth.uid() AND role = 'admin'))\n    WITH CHECK (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles WHERE id = auth.uid() AND role = 'admin'));\n\n-- ----------------------------------------\n-- RECURRING SCHEDULES POLICIES\n-- ----------------------------------------\n\n-- All authenticated users can read schedules\nCREATE POLICY \"Authenticated can read recurring_schedules\" ON recurring_schedules\n    FOR SELECT TO authenticated\n    USING (true);\n\n-- Coaches and admins can manage schedules\nCREATE POLICY \"Coaches can manage recurring_schedules\" ON recurring_schedules\n    FOR ALL TO authenticated\n    USING (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles WHERE id = auth.uid() AND role IN ('coach', 'admin')))\n    WITH CHECK (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM profiles WHERE id = auth.uid() AND role IN ('coach', 'admin')));\n\n-- ----------------------------------------\n-- RESERVATIONS POLICIES\n-- ----------------------------------------\n\n-- All authenticated users can read active reservations\nCREATE POLICY \"Authenticated can read active reservations\" ON reservations\n    FOR SELECT TO authenticated\n    USING (status = 'active');\n\n-- Users can create their own personal reservations\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can create own reservations\" ON reservations\n    FOR INSERT TO authenticated\n    WITH CHECK (\n        user_id IN (\n            SELECT id FROM profiles \n            WHERE user_id IN (\n                SELECT id FROM public.users \n                WHERE auth_user_id = auth.uid()\n            )\n        ) AND \n        reservation_type = 'personal'\n    );\n\n-- Users can update their own reservations\nCREATE POLICY \"Users can update own reservations\" ON reservations\n    FOR UPDATE TO authenticated\n    USING (\n        ",

      "codeBlock": {

        "contents": "### &#96;auth.jwt()&#96;\n\nReturns the JWT of the user making the request. Anything that you store in the user's &#96;raw_app_meta_data&#96; column or the &#96;raw_user_meta_data&#96; column will be accessible using this function. It's important to know the distinction between these two:\n\n- &#96;raw_user_meta_data&#96; - can be updated by the authenticated user using the &#96;supabase.auth.update()&#96; function. It is not a good place to store authorization data.\n- &#96;raw_app_meta_data&#96; - cannot be updated by the user, so it's a good place to store authorization data.\n\nThe &#96;auth.jwt()&#96; function is extremely versatile. For example, if you store some team data inside &#96;app_metadata&#96;, you can use it to determine whether a particular user belongs to a team. For example, if this was an array of IDs:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"User is in team\"\non my_table\nto authenticated\nusing ( team_id in (select auth.jwt() -&gt; 'app_metadata' -&gt; 'teams'));\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### MFA\n\nThe &#96;auth.jwt()&#96; function can be used to check for [Multi-Factor Authentication](mdc:docs/guides/auth/auth-mfa#enforce-rules-for-mfa-logins). For example, you could restrict a user from updating their profile unless they have at least 2 levels of authentication (Assurance Level 2):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Restrict updates.\"\non profiles\nas restrictive\nfor update\nto authenticated using (\n  (select auth.jwt()-&gt;&gt;'aal') = 'aal2'\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## RLS performance recommendations\n\nEvery authorization system has an impact on performance. While row level security is powerful, the performance impact is important to keep in mind. This is especially true for queries that scan every row in a table - like many &#96;select&#96; operations, including those using limit, offset, and ordering.\n\nBased on a series of [tests](mdc:https:/github.com/GaryAustin1/RLS-Performance), we have a few recommendations for RLS:\n\n### Add indexes\n\nMake sure you've added [indexes](mdc:docs/guides/database/postgres/indexes) on any columns used within the Policies which are not already indexed (or primary keys). For a Policy like this:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate policy \"Users can access their own records\" on test_table",

        "contents": "4. **School Email Verification** - Unverified users must:\n   - Enter their school email (@pef.czu.cz)\n   - System checks if email is in pre-registered list\n   - If valid, sends 6-digit verification code\n   - User enters code to complete verification\n5. **Access Granted** - Verified users access the dashboard\n\n## Database Schema\n\n### Tables\n\n#### &#96;profiles&#96;\nExtended user info linked to Supabase auth.users\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK, FK → auth.users.id) | No | Links to Supabase auth |\n| full_name | TEXT | No | User's display name |\n| role | ENUM ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin') | No | User role |\n| team_id | UUID (FK → teams.id) | Yes | Assigned team (students/team leaders only) |\n| is_verified | BOOLEAN | No | School email verified? Default: false |\n| school_email | TEXT | Yes | Verified school email |\n| locale | TEXT | No | Preferred language ('cs', 'en'). Default: 'cs' |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Registration time |\n| updated_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Last update time |\n\n#### &#96;teams&#96;\nTeam companies (tymove firmy)\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK) | No | Team identifier |\n| name | TEXT | No | Team name |\n| year | INTEGER | No | Cohort year (1, 2, 3) |\n| is_active | BOOLEAN | No | Still active team? Default: true |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Creation time |\n\n#### &#96;pre_registered_emails&#96;\nAdmin-imported student list from Excel\n\n| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |\n|--------|------|----------|-------------|\n| id | UUID (PK) | No | Record identifier |\n| email | TEXT (unique) | No | School email from Excel |\n| team_id | UUID (FK → teams.id) | No | Assigned team |\n| role | ENUM | No | Expected role |\n| full_name | TEXT | Yes | Name from Excel (optional) |\n| claimed_by | UUID (FK → profiles.id) | Yes | User who claimed this email |\n| claimed_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | Yes | When claimed |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMPTZ | No | Import time |\n\n#### &#96;verification_codes&#96;",
